article.headline: Horner’s 22 lead Jacksonville State over Pacific 83-76
article.description: — Leon Horner scored 22 points as Jacksonville State beat Pacific 83-76 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Horner’s 22 lead Jacksonville State over Pacific 83-76
article.story: LAS VEGAS -- — Leon Horner scored 22 points as Jacksonville State beat Pacific 83-76 on Wednesday. Horner also added six assists for the Gamecocks (4-3). Jordan Stiemke added 19 points while going 6 of 8 from the floor, including 5 for 5 from 3-point range, and 2 for 3 from the line while he also had five rebounds. Chris Lockett Jr. had 19 points and shot 5 of 14 from the field, including 1 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 8 for 11 from the line. CJ Jones finished with 19 points and three steals for the Tigers (5-2). Jaion Pitt added 17 points and seven assists for Pacific. Adriel Nyorha also had 11 points. Jacksonville State took the lead for good with 6:47 remaining in the second half on a free throw from Ethan Croley to make it a 66-65 game. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
